title: Send request
description: POST /participant/v1/messages. from must be an open session of the caller; to is name@host or name@participant (a bare name is refused). The same id from the same sender applied twice stores and offers once. Unknown fields are ignored by the gateway on a request and must be ignored by a client on a response.

body.description: At most 64 KiB (65536 bytes) of UTF-8. The limit is in bytes; maxLength counts characters, so it is only a first check.
